_comment: Two kinds of eval, with very different strength.
ROUTING cases score a query against every skill description by term overlap.
This is a PROXY for how the model selects a skill, not a reproduction of it:
it cannot see meaning, and it cannot see Portuguese. What it does prove is
that a description still carries its trigger vocabulary -- which is the way
descriptions actually rot. Real multilingual routing is checked live in
phase 5 by asking a model to choose from catalog.md.
KNOWLEDGE cases are the strong ones. Each asserts that a claim written in a
skill still matches the repository. When a cited symbol is renamed, the eval
goes red and the skill is flagged stale instead of quietly lying.
